description: One Cardano stake pool: name, ticker, status, margin (percent), fixed cost and pledge (ADA), live and active stake (ADA), saturation (percent), delegators, blocks minted, estimated and recently realised yearly return (percent), description and homepage. `performance` lists its last finished epochs (blocks minted against blocks expected from its stake, luck in percent, the return delegators got) and says how many epochs are on record. Pass `stakeAda` to also get `rewardEstimate`: the ADA that amount is expected to earn per epoch and per year in this pool, with what the estimate assumes.

poolId.description: Bech32 pool id (pool1…) or its 56-hex form. Get it from `search` or `list_stake_pools`.

stakeAda.description: Optional amount of ADA to delegate: adds an estimate of its staking reward in this pool.

name: get_stake_pool
title: Stake pool detail
